description: Murten’s harbour sits on the lake below the hill town, and this frame looks out across Lake Murten from the pier, with the quay, a few boats, and reeds in the foreground. Mont Vully is the low ridge on the far shore. The ring wall and castle are behind the camera, so this is not the walled-town scene already catalogued. The Open-Meteo model is fully overcast and mild, with no rain.
